channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Man's summer house allowed despite neighbours' complaints over its height
item.description: A man's request for retrospective planning permission over his summer house on Wroxham Road has been approved by planners despite fears from neighbours.

item.title: Fireman sacked for throwing phone denied further tribunal hearing
item.description: John Linden, a senior fireman sacked for throwing a disabled man's phone, has been denied an employment tribunal rethink over claims Norfolk Fire Service failed to accommodate his disability.

item.title: Clock ticking for decision on new schools in two Norfolk towns
item.description: The clock is ticking for councillors to decide whether or not to use government money to build two new schools in Norfolk.

item.title: Mystery surrounds person who triggered day-long search on city river
item.description: Police confirm they have identified the owner of the belongings found near the River Wensum in December, which led to a dramatic search in the water.

item.title: Historic gem showcases paintings created by students at city school
item.description: A historic site in Theatre Street is hosting an art exhibition for a special needs school that recently celebrated its 120th anniversary.

item.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's new home hit by internet outage
item.description: The Norfolk village where Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor plans to relocate has been plagued by an internet outage.

item.title: Mum 'living again' after shedding more than 5st in eight months
item.description: A mum from Mildenhall has shared her Slimming World success story after losing more than five stone in eight months

item.title: RAF commander gives farm managers advice on leadership under pressure
item.description: RAF Marham station commander Group Captain Leonie Boyd has shared her leadership strategies with Norfolk farm business managers - helping them to stay battle-ready in an uncertain world.

item.title: Bid for 'high quality' new self-build homes on plot of land
item.description: A bid has been made to install five new self-build homes on a plot of land in Corton, near Lowestoft.

item.title: I can never say again: 'Lock him up and throw away the key'
item.description: 'Lock Him up and Throw away the Key'
